definition: Complete individual bookcase from floor/plinth to the top of its attached carved crown; excludes separate lettering, wall frieze and room cornice.
method: Visual proportional estimates, one representative full-case estimate per full-room image, equally weighted. These are not measurements of known physical dimensions. Pixel spans are approximate visual readings at 2048 px image width, not solved camera geometry.

images.label: Empty cases with branching arches
images.basis: No reliable independent human-sized object. About eight shelf levels plus a tall arched crown; assume typical shelf pitch of 0.35–0.45 m. Low-confidence cross-check against the furnished scenes.

images.label: Empty two-bay cases
images.basis: No reliable independent human-sized object. Broad two-bay cases with about seven shelf openings, dado and carved crown; inferred using 0.35–0.45 m shelf pitch. Low confidence.

images.label: Empty cases beside window benches
images.basis: Rear bookcase floor-to-crown roughly 330–340 px in a 2048 px-wide view. Nearby bench seat-to-floor about 32–36 px. Assuming a 0.45–0.50 m seat height gives roughly 4.1–5.3 m before perspective uncertainty.

images.label: Furnished library with armchairs
images.basis: Rear cases roughly 3.5–4 times nearby chair-back heights; assumed chair backs 0.85–1.0 m above floor. Visible books provide a loose 0.25–0.30 m height cross-check. Chair and case depths differ.

images.label: Large gold callouts above three-bay cases
images.basis: Rear case floor-to-crown around 300–315 px in a 2048 px-wide view; adjacent bench seat-to-floor roughly 35–40 px. Assume a 0.45–0.50 m seat height; cross-check about seven broad shelf openings plus dado and crown.

images.label: Arched case crowns and central upholstered bench
images.basis: Rear case floor-to-crown approximately 390 px in a 2048 px-wide view; center bench seat-to-floor about 35–40 px. Assume a 0.45–0.50 m seat height; perspective and interpretation of the upholstery edge dominate uncertainty.

images.label: Book-filled concept with rolling ladders
images.basis: Books, chair backs and ladder rungs give overlapping but inconsistent scales. Rear case floor-to-crown about 430 px versus typical depicted book spines of roughly 27–33 px. Assume books about 0.25–0.30 m tall, with chair-back cross-check.

images.label: Pale-stone, book-filled library
images.basis: About eight to nine densely occupied shelf levels plus cornice. Rear case roughly 400–440 px and representative book spines about 36–42 px in a 2048 px-wide view; assuming books 0.25–0.30 m tall suggests around 3 m. No independent furniture anchor.

interpretation: About 4.2 m (14 ft) overall. Treat about 3.5–5 m as a practical uncertainty band around the aggregate estimate, not a statistical confidence interval. A range of roughly 3–5.5 m covers most individual cases inferred here.
other_references: Both multiview images are excluded entirely: the user supplied them strictly for window detail. The Immersion event diagram is also excluded. Only the eight full-room library images inform the shelving estimates. No dimensions from the 32.86 m Blender hall were used to force the image estimates.
